text:
ana: Quick heads up — the cutover queue is backed up after the schema migration. We should prioritize hotfix PRs and decide whether to slip the public ETA. I'm leaning toward a controlled slip to finish validation rather than a risky push. @channel

josh: On it, triaging PRs now. Do we want prioritization rules? My suggestion: security/data-path > perf/regressions > infra fixes > docs. Agree?

maria: agree with that ordering. I can assemble the changelog tonight if you send me the PR list and authors.

ana: typo — ana: I can tag PRs with `ship-now`. Josh, can you paste the list when you're done? I'll keep the changelog as minimal "hotfix" entries.

josh: Here's the quick filter I'm using: `gh pr list --base release/0.12.x --state open --label hotfix --json number,title,author,labels` — will paste the top 12 that match security/data-path.

release-bot: CI: build/2007654321 started for branch `release/0.12.x` — job id 6321.

release-bot: CI: build/2007654321 failed — flaky failure in `tests/kv_cache/test_eviction.py` (retrying).

tim: If CI keeps failing we should avoid a hard cutover. Alternative: cherry-pick the 3 clear hotfixes into a clean branch and run fast-path tests. Who can do cherry-picks? :thinking_face:

sasha: I can pick the three security PRs (will do picks and run `./scripts/fast-ci.sh`). Ping me the PR numbers.

ana: ana: draft announce copy below — please review, keep short. Intend to post to #announcements if we confirm slip.

ana: ```
Heads up: Targeted release for 0.12.x will move to 2026-03-18 17:00 UTC due to extended validation after a schema migration. We will land critical hotfixes as they clear CI; expect incremental rollouts. We'll post a follow-up by 10:00 PT with detailed changelog. Thanks for your patience.
```

josh: +1 on copy. Small tweak: say "critical hotfixes" -> "critical hotfixes & safety rollouts" to signal staged deploy.

maria: For the changelog I'll need: PR number, short one-line summary, author handle. If you add the `ship-now` label I'll pick them up.

josh: Pasting first five candidates: #4831 (fix: kv-cache eviction under race) @hannah, #4827 (fix: auth token leak) @devin, #4819 (perf: batcher backpressure) @li, #4845 (infra: better healthcheck) @marc, #4850 (test: flaky test skip) @sandra. Marked with `ship-now` where appropriate.

release-bot: CI: retried build/2007654321 — attempt 2 running.

tim: Sasha — if you finish cherry-picks, can you open PRs against `release/0.12.x` and tag me for approval? I can merge after CI green for fast-path tests.

sasha: Will do, starting now. ETA ~45m for picks + push.

ana: If we decide to post slip to #announcements, plan: 1) Post copy above, 2) link changelog once Maria attaches it, 3) mention expected update time (10:00 PT). Anyone object?

josh: No objections. Post it if CI doesn't clear in 1h. :+1:

maria: Working on changelog; I'll upload a Gist and share link when ready.

sasha: CHERRYPICK commands I'm using:```
git checkout -b rel/0.12x-hotfixes
git fetch origin release/0.12.x
git cherry-pick -x <pr-commit-sha>  # repeat for each
git push origin rel/0.12x-hotfixes
```

ana: Thanks team. I'll hold the announcement draft and post once we confirm the slip. If picks land cleanly we might avoid public ETA change.

josh: Quick note to on-call: if we see rollout regressions after hotfix merges, please flip the router to canary mode and hold. Ping me.

maria: Gist with changelog draft: https://gist.github.com/redwood/changelog-0.12.4-draft — small entries, awaiting final PR numbers.

ana: Final — marking `last_message` here. Will update thread after announcement. :wave:
